newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PPC to start building Saldanha slag mill.
newsitem.headline: PPC to start building Saldanha slag mill.

text.p: Pretoria Portland Cement Co Ltd said on Thursday it would start with the construction of the proposed slag mill at Saldanha Steel in April, based on the outcome of an Environmental Impact Report (EIR).
"Based on the outcome of the EIR, PPC has decided to proceed with the project, and plans to commence construction of the mill in April," the company said in a statement.
The slag mill would grind approximately 230,000 tonnes of Corex Slag by-product generated annually by Saldanha Steel.

PPC said some of the material would be sold by PPC Cement directly to the building and construction industry, and the balance blended to create more affordable blended cements for the Western Cape market.
PPC said it was committed to the recommendations of the EIR regarding air pollution, noise, traffic, environmental management planning and social impact.
